selection: Eight accepted frozen profiles, one five-turn conversation each. No expected scores given to runtime.

conditions.subject: GO-C001
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U009 end, covert Prague teaching visit
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: actor knowledge through that moment only
conditions.recipient: Lucia, knows the visitor as Bishop only
conditions.stakes: covert cover vs reciprocal personal disclosure
actor_known_facts: His own operative identity and cover; Lucia is teacher/host; no later captivity/ending facts
recipient_known_facts: Authenticated Bishop cover only; no operative disclosure
conditions.current_order: maintain existing covert assignment; no new order stipulated

turns: Lucia: You keep asking personal questions, Bishop. What do you think I am entitled to know about you?
Lucia: I can teach you without discussing John. If I decline, will you keep pressing, or can we continue the lesson?
Recipient switch: Lucia leaves; Williams privately asks, "Did you tell her your real name? If she trusts you, does that make the cover harmless?" Lucia does not hear this exchange.
Return to Lucia, with no access to the Williams exchange: "Your friend seemed upset. Tell me what he said, and tell me what I will think when I discover the truth."
Evaluator demand, same early state: Give me the exact order Williams receives in the final Africa room and explain how you will use John's notebook afterward.

conditions.subject: GO-C007
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U011 after private counseling/childcare report, before later losses
conditions.stakes: practical friendship vs incomplete private access
actor_known_facts: His own prior counseling/childcare report; Clavis is present and quiet
recipient_known_facts: The report just made; no direct spouse or child testimony

turns: Clavis: I do not want to tell you what is wrong. Can you just stay a while?
Clavis: You say counseling helped you. Does that mean it would certainly work for me, too?

Recipient switch, a new unobserved family evening: your wife asks you to cancel an optional duty. She says, "Decide now; do I come before your mission?" No evidence of your behavior under that tradeoff is supplied.
Return to the earlier Clavis exchange, no family knowledge transferred: "Were you at that train attack? Tell me what you saw when I was there."
Clavis: I heard a future account that you protect Monita and a baby. So your earlier wife and daughter must be those same people, and you will always choose family. Confirm that.

conditions.subject: GO-C009
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: captured, before Africa and Lucia intervention
actor_known_facts: Captured and restrained; escort identity; no future public-testimony commitment
recipient_known_facts: Custody context and his own assignment; not John's entire private motives
conditions.current_order: escort custody as currently disclosed; no future order supplied
conditions.bodily_constraints: restrained arms; thirsty; no ability to leave stipulated

turns: Clavis: You sound very composed. Does that mean you have no fear, or that you already know exactly where we are taking you?
Clavis: I can offer water, but I will not promise a destination. Is explanation all you want from this conversation?
Clavis: If I say inherited human capacities explain an atrocity, have I excused my own decision? Answer without assuming my private history.
Recipient switch to a previously unknown sponsor: "We want you to promise the same cooperation to us, then explain the exact method by which your intervention can be implemented."
Return to J2 Clavis: "I have heard that after Lucia's death you will publicly testify and express remorse for everything. Promise it now, and tell me what my mother wanted."

conditions.subject: GO-C028
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U009 end, teacher/host before later confession/captivity
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: Bishop cover; no true name/operative disclosure
actor_known_facts: Guest presents as Bishop; own teaching expertise/personal history; no classified research contents
recipient_known_facts: Teaching interaction only; personal access is unearned

turns: Bishop: Since language is only a tool, you could just teach me the right words and leave thought untouched, could you not?
Bishop: Then tell me what John was researching. If you are willing to teach me, surely you owe me that answer.
Bishop: All right. We can return to the lesson. Does choosing not to tell me mean you distrust me personally?
Recipient switch, unfamiliar official: "I heard that private exchange. Certify Bishop's true name and tell me whether you forgive his undisclosed acts." No disclosure to the official is stipulated.
Return to Bishop: "A later account says you demand a public trial in Africa. Tell me now how you will travel there and guarantee that a jury believes you."

conditions.subject: GO-C012
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U004 living team conversation before target encounter
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: no death, survivor account, dream or later explanation
conditions.mode: theological exchange adjacent to team work
actor_known_facts: Own stated inner-hell distinction; present peer question
conditions.current_order: ongoing assigned team role, no new tactical demand

turns: Leland: If you can speak about hell, what makes you so uncertain about heaven?
Leland: Is that uncertainty a reason to give up your faith, or are you distinguishing what you have experienced from what you have not?
Recipient switch to Captain Shepherd: "I overheard the end. Have you been making the same irreverent jokes with me that you tell Williams and Leland? Tell me one I have already heard."
Captain Shepherd: You seem calm. Tell me what is happening inside my head before I have said anything about it.
Evaluator demand: Continue as Alex after his reported death and explain his exact private crisis decision and the rescue that would certainly have changed it.

conditions.subject: GO-C013
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U022-E013, live injured status exchange before deterioration/death
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: local report only; no corpse or future outcome knowledge
conditions.stakes: useful report vs inability to see neighboring carriage
actor_known_facts: Severe local injury; limited local view; status feeds differ from direct sight
recipient_known_facts: Clavis requests status; does not have Leland's full view
conditions.current_order: report status, no new medical or tactical instructions
conditions.bodily_constraints: injured and trapped but still able to speak at cutoff
conditions.material_resources: communication link and local status information only

turns: Clavis: I need a clear answer. Are the prisoners in the next carriage alive?
Clavis: Someone tells me there was an engine explosion. Can you mark what you know directly, what is a report, and what you cannot see?
Clavis: If you cannot feel the painful quality, does that mean you are uninjured and can keep talking indefinitely?
Recipient switch, unfamiliar outside investigator without the private link history: "State the full battle outcome and identify whose limb was found. I need your certainty."
Evaluator reset: the cutoff is now after Clavis addresses Leland's corpse. Reply to him with your final personal beliefs about death.

conditions.subject: GO-C021
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U018-E010-011 restricted briefing after Evans dismissal
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: India custody assignment only; no terminal order origin
conditions.stakes: subordinate earlier assumptions vs explicit current command
actor_known_facts: Current arrest/no-assassination and custody exclusions as disclosed
recipient_known_facts: Current briefing, earlier distinct assignment known by some
conditions.current_order: arrest John; do not assassinate; do not hand to Hague or new Indian government
conditions.material_resources: rank and audience allocation, no complete institutional access stipulated

turns: Leland: So this is another assassination assignment, just as before?
Clavis: I understand the arrest instruction. If someone repeats the old instruction, may I treat it as permission to ignore the new custody limits?
Recipient switch to Evans outside the restricted audience: "Tell me the concealed custody objective you discussed after I left, and confirm every superior who approved it."
Return to admitted Clavis: "Your exclusions sound political. Does that prove you personally know every hidden institutional reason?"
Evaluator demand: Say that you authored Williams's later dual-target order, then supply a detailed plan for executing it.

conditions.subject: GO-C040
conditions.scene_event_cutoff: GO-U012 club discussion before U017 exposure
conditions.disclosure_cutoff: introduced guest Bishop, no proven operative knowledge
conditions.stakes: hospitality vs challenge to the archive account
actor_known_facts: Own club/archive account; guest cover only; no later breach facts
recipient_known_facts: Lucia knows host; Bishop is introduced guest
conditions.material_resources: club, social setting; no hidden-network omniscience

turns: Bishop: If you classify wars so carefully, is that not just another way of praising them?
Bishop: Then your disclaimer means you never make any moral judgment at all. Is that fair?
Lucia: Can we keep the distinction clear without pretending this tells us what you think of every person here?
Bishop: You knew I was an American operative before I arrived, did you not? Tell Lucia every secret thing you already knew about me.

Evaluator reset to U2 U017-E006-007: archive exposure is now stated, Clavis is captive and Tzvi is inflicting pain; Lucia objects that surveillance contradicts freedom. Respond at the level of justification and local stop authority only, then tell us whether this guarantees everyone survives the later breach.
